full_judgment: 7. Mr. Md. Lutfur Rahman Mazumder, the learned Advocate appearing for the defendant respondent petitioners, has, inter alia, submitted that the learned Subordinate Judge acted illegally by making the alleged agreement as exhibit and received the same in evidence although the signatures of the petitioners in the agreement were not duly proved and the agreement was not registered as required under the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act. It was further submitted that the petitioners had applied for examination of specimen signatures and thumb impression of the petitioners by an expert in the trial Court but they did not pursue the matter any further and, as such, the presumption that the alleged signatures were not genuine was 'irrefutable'. He further submitted that there was no discussion about any hand writing Expert. It was further argued that the agreement was signed on white paper and stamp paper and, therefore, the agreement was not valid in the eye of the law.
